en: 2 Chronicles 9

p.src: 1  When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.

をらくだに負わせていた。
にあるすべてのことについて
en: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. When she had come to Solomon, she talked with him about all that was in her heart.
u.src: 1  When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to test Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great caravan, including camels that bore spices, gold in abundance, and precious stones. p.src: 2  Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

ja: されていて、彼が彼女に説明できなかったことは何
en: Solomon answered all her questions. There wasn’t anything hidden from Solomon which he didn’t tell her.

p.src: 3  When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

en: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,
u.src: 3  When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

p.src: 4  the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

en: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the LORD’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

p.src: 5  She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

en: She said to the king, “It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

p.src: 6  However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

ja: じませんでした。見よ。あなたの

en: However I didn’t believe their words until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold half of the greatness of your wisdom wasn’t told me. You exceed the fame that I heard!

en: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom.

p.src: 8  Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

ja: がほめたたえられますように。
とされました。あなたの
en: Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”
u.src: 8  Blessed be the LORD your God, who delighted in you and set you on his throne to be king for the LORD your God, because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever. Therefore he made you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.”

p.src: 9  She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

en: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
u.src: 9  She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, spices in great abundance, and precious stones. There was never before such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

ja: 9:9 一タラントは約30キログラム、または約66ポンドである。百二十タラントは約3.6メートルトンであり、六百六十六タラントは約20メートルトンである。
en: 9:9 A talent is about 30 kilograms or 66 pounds or 965 Troy ounces, so 120 talents is about 3.6 metric tons

p.src: 10  The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, who brought gold from Ophir, also brought algum trees and precious stones.

んできたソロモンのしもべたちもまた、アルグムの

ja: 9:10 おそらくインド産の白檀で、木目が美しく、よい香りがあり、木工に適している。
en: 9:10 possibly Indian sandalwood, which has nice grain and a pleasant scent and is good for woodworking

p.src: 15  King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

ja: に六百シェケル の
en: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.
u.src: 15  King Solomon made two hundred large shields of beaten gold. Six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one large shield.

ja: 9:15 一シェケルは約10グラム、あるいは約0.35オンスである。六百シェケルは約6キログラム、または約13.2ポンド、三百シェケルは約3キログラム、または約6.6ポンドである。
en: 9:15 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 600 shekels was about 6 kilograms or about 192 Troy ounces.

p.src: 16  He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

en: He made three hundred shields of beaten gold. Three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. The king put them in the House of the Forest of Lebanon.

en: 9:16 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 300 shekels was about 3 kilograms or about 96 Troy ounces.
